misconceptions.description: Reading whatever aggregation the pivot defaults to as the answer, without checking whether Sum, Count, or Average matches the question asked
misconceptions.trigger: learner reports a pivot total without confirming the value field setting
misconceptions.feedback: Match the aggregation to the question. Use Sum for totals, Count for how many records, and Average for typical size. Set this in Value Field Settings.

misconceptions.description: Assuming a pivot table updates automatically when new rows are added, even though its source range was fixed to the original data
misconceptions.trigger: learner adds rows and the pivot totals do not change after refresh
misconceptions.feedback: A pivot only summarizes the range it was given. Expand the source range or base the pivot on an Excel Table so added rows are included on refresh.

misconceptions.description: Reading the pivot Grand Total row as if it were a single category subtotal rather than the total across all categories
misconceptions.trigger: learner cites the Grand Total when a per-region figure was needed
misconceptions.feedback: The Grand Total combines every category. Read the individual region rows for per-category figures, not the bottom total.
